findings.desc: CHK-002:adversarial:0 verificationIntent explicitly promises that missing/stale/contradictory host probe evidence invalidates fallback records for BOTH eligibility=single-host-environment AND eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability. Implementation (reviewHostAvailabilityProbeRequiredForEligibility in packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:548-550) does gate both values identically, but no verificationEvidence actually exercises eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability anywhere: grep for the literal string across packages/main/src/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.ts, packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts, and tests/ finds zero matches (it only appears in production source: review-escalation.ts, command-policy.ts, command-schemas.ts). The recorded CHK-002:adversarial:0 evidence note itself only claims single-host-environment coverage ("reject single-host-environment fallback when a fresh probe shows two or more executable canonical hosts"), which is narrower than the intent text it is meant to satisfy. Add a smoke check that constructs a review_escalation_fallback record with eligibility=temporary-host-unavailability and asserts it is rejected under missing/stale probe evidence the same way single-host-environment is, in both evaluateReviewEscalation and evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by adding temporary-host-unavailability missing/stale/two-host rejection coverage to review-escalation-smoke and review-assurance-floor-smoke; verified by build, both smokes, the two missed suites, and root npm run test.

findings.desc: regression: CHK-002's new host-availability-probe gate on review_escalation_fallback_set / reviewEscalationFallbackRecordFromEvent (packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:580-653, esp. the required hostAvailabilityProbeId+command+authorityDone checks at lines 600-636) breaks two pre-existing smoke suites that ARE wired into the root `npm run test` chain (package.json:15 lists both test:review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash-smoke and test:review-escalation-freshness-root). Reproduced by building (npm --prefix packages/main run build) and running the compiled tasks directly: (1) node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash-smoke.js throws AssertionError 'fallback record must be valid under storyFilesHash match' (false !== true) at check (d) because packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash-smoke.ts:76-93 builds a review_escalation_fallback event for eligibility=single-host-environment without command/hostAvailabilityProbeId/authorityDone fields, and the story's diff did not update this fixture file. (2) node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-freshness-root-smoke.js throws an uncaught Error 'no fresh review_host_availability_probe record found for current material' because packages/main/src/tasks/review-escalation-freshness-root-smoke.ts:519-531 calls handlers.review_escalation_fallback_set({eligibility:'single-host-environment',...}) directly without first calling review_host_availability_probe, and this fixture file was likewise not updated. Only review-escalation-smoke.ts and review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts (the two files the plan.md CHK-002/CHK-003 sections named) were updated with probe fixtures; two other existing call sites of the same eligibility values were missed, so `npm run test` (and therefore any CI/validate path that runs it) now fails on this branch. Fix: add review_host_availability_probe fixture events (or switch eligibility to explicit-human-approval) in both missed smoke files so they reflect the new required contract, then rerun `npm run test` to confirm green.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed the two missed root-chain smokes: review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash now includes a fresh host availability probe fixture and review-escalation-freshness-root uses explicit-human-approval for gitCwd/material binding; verified by the two target smokes and root npm run test.
